name: grok-build
description: Grok Build Desktop — Electron agent app over official Grok CLI (ACP). Not Grok Build IDE.

scripts.build: npm run build:acp && npm run build:sessions
scripts.icons: npm run electron:install && node apps/desktop/build/generate-icon.mjs && node apps/desktop/build/stamp-dev-electron-icon.cjs
scripts.desktop: npm run electron:install && npm run icons:stamp-dev && npm run build && npm run start -w @grok-build/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run dist -w @grok-build/desktop
scripts.check:visual: node scripts/verify-desktop-layout.mjs && node scripts/verify-slash-menu.mjs && node scripts/verify-codex-session-ui.mjs && node scripts/verify-session-tabs.mjs && node scripts/verify-project-explorer.mjs && node scripts/verify-resizable-panes.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/test-slash-commands.mjs && node scripts/test-syntax-highlight.mjs && node scripts/test-session-move.mjs && node scripts/test-session-context.mjs && node scripts/test-project-session-sync-ui.mjs && node scripts/test-sidebar-project-runtime.mjs && node scripts/e2e-desktop.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:arch && npm run check:packaging && npm run check:brand && npm run check:release && npm test && npm run check:visual
